name: use-media-query
title: useMediaQuery / usePrefersReducedMotion
description: The system's one matchMedia subscription — useSyncExternalStore with a declared serverFallback, so SSR renders the branch the caller chose instead of a hard-coded false. usePrefersReducedMotion is the named reduced-motion reader over it.

meta.whenToUse: JavaScript genuinely has to branch on a media query — mounting a different component tree, skipping a requestAnimationFrame loop, enabling pointer drag.
meta.whenNotToUse: A purely visual responsive change: a Tailwind breakpoint or a container query does it in CSS with no hydration cost.
